description:
Check a shopping or gift list: for each item, which scored company it belongs to (if any), the cited
    facts Shoptegrity holds (parent, filings, shareholder payouts) and what is withheld. Items can be products,
    brands or stores, such as 'AirPods', 'Tide pods' or 'Walmart'. Up to 50 items.
name: check_cart
title: Check a shopping list
